candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All characters correct including 問い合わせる and the ③ ending た。 Furigana けいさい is captured as (けいさい). Box rendered as blockquote rather than a table/box, which is acceptable but not ideal; blanks rendered as full-width underscores. No inventions.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Text accurate (問い合わせる correct, ③ ends た). Missing the furigana けいさい on 掲載. Box rendered as a table with an awkward empty header row; ③'s blank split across two lines mirrors the image layout. No hallucinations.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Misreads 問い合わせる as 聞い合わせる and ③'s final た as だ. Furigana けいさい omitted. Table uses the first word row as a header row, distorting the box; H1 heading for the exercise title is not faithful to layout.

rationale: A is the most faithful: every character matches the image, it uniquely preserves the furigana けいさい, and it invents nothing; its only weakness is a slightly loose rendering of the word box. B is nearly as accurate textually but omits the furigana and uses an awkward table structure with an empty header row. C ranks last due to two substantive character errors (聞い合わせる for 問い合わせる, だ for た), the missing furigana, and formatting issues (word list forced into a table header, unnecessary H1).
